services.description: New patient registration, medical record opening and ID card
Clinical evaluation and physical examination by General Practitioner
In-depth consultation with specialized medical doctor
Automated 5-part differential blood cell counter evaluating anemia and infection
Plasmodium falciparum antigen detection and blood film microscopy
Serum glucose measurement to evaluate diabetes mellitus and glycemic control
Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, and Triglycerides assessment
Urine chemistry strip and microscopic sediment examination
Salmonella antibody titers for enteric fever screening
ALT, AST, ALP, Bilirubin, and Total Protein
Ova, parasite, and cysts microscopic examination for intestinal infections
Rapid chromatographic immunoassay for Helicobacter pylori detection
Rapid diagnostic screening test for antibodies to HIV-1 and HIV-2
Rapid chromatographic immunoassay for qualitative detection of HBsAg
Immunoassay test for qualitative detection of antibodies to Hepatitis C virus
Qualitative determination of human chorionic gonadotropin for early pregnancy
Forward ABO blood grouping and Rhesus (Rh-D) antigen determination
Photometric measurement of blood hemoglobin level for anemia screening
Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea Nitrogen, and glomerular filtration assessment
